stories.title: Luxurious Bath Complex Used by Roman Emperor Found in Serbia
stories.label: world
stories.summary: Archaeologists in Serbia have uncovered a stunning ancient Roman bath complex that once belonged to Emperor Maximinus Daza. The site includes three separate bathing pools and even a sauna, showing off some seriously impressive engineering for its time. It's a rare, well-preserved glimpse into daily luxury from the late Roman Empire. Finds like this help historians piece together how people actually lived nearly 1,700 years ago. It's a nice reminder that the past still has surprises buried just beneath our feet.
stories.why_good: A genuine, newly confirmed archaeological discovery that enriches our understanding of history with no political, criminal, or tragic undertone.
